prompt: On the Dashboard, all of the widget cards re-render roughly once a second even when I'm not touching anything. What's causing it?

truth.summary: PreferencesProvider re-renders every second for its sync clock and passes a new `{ density, setDensity }` object as the context value, so every consumer re-renders.

referenceAnswer.cause: PreferencesProvider creates a new context value object on every render (it re-renders each second for the sync clock), so all consumers re-render.

decoyAnswer.cause: The widgets array is recreated on each render.

referenceFix.find: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
referenceFix.replace: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'

const [syncedSecondsAgo, setSyncedSecondsAgo] = useState(0)
  const preferences = useMemo(() => ({ density, setDensity }), [density])
